# Brit Adventures

> > Brit Adventures is a comprehensive travel resource for British travelers exploring New Zealand on working holiday visas and gap year adventures.

The site provides detailed guides for working holiday visa holders, backpackers, and gap year travelers navigating New Zealand's North and South Islands. Content covers practical visa information, regional travel guides, and iconic destinations from Auckland to Queenstown.

## Key Topics

- New Zealand working holiday visa
- Gap year travel
- Backpacker guides
- Auckland travel
- North Island destinations
- South Island destinations
- Rotorua geothermal attractions
- Queenstown adventure tourism
- Coromandel Peninsula
- Hobbiton movie set
- Cathedral Cove
- Hot Water Beach
- Mount Maunganui
- Christchurch
- Regional hiking trails

## Working Holiday & Visa Information

- [New Zealand Working Holiday Hub](https://www.britadventures.com/new-zealand-working-holiday): Working holiday visa guide for New Zealand with Auckland and regional info
